comment: The upload contains lab_notebook_extract.tsv, a data file (accepted extension) that is not listed under any role in manifest.tsv. Under the manifest scheme a file listed as a role (e.g. 'unstranded') is valid under any filename, so the old premise here (counts.tsv rejected as an unrecognised stem) no longer applies; this fixture now targets the unreferenced-extra-file check instead.
expected_technical_error_regex: Upload contains file\(s\) not listed in the manifest.*lab_notebook_extract\.tsv
expected_user_error_regex: There was a problem with the structure of your upload
